usage: `odsc.excludedclasses=<值>` / `odsc.excludedclasses <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls what packages will be ignored during material loading to speed it up. This will exclude uassets inheriting from these classes\n

usage: `ODSC.MaterialUpdateFlags=<值>` / `ODSC.MaterialUpdateFlags <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Changes the material update flags when ODSC receives new shaders and needs to update the materials\n

usage: `odsc.shadermaps.lifetime=<值>` / `odsc.shadermaps.lifetime <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls how many shader recompiles can happen before deleting an unused shadermap. Higher values means more memory, but faster iteration time\n

usage: `odsc.shadermaps.numbeforegc=<值>` / `odsc.shadermaps.numbeforegc <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls how many shader maps we keep in memory before we start deleting them. Higher values means more memory, but faster iteration time\n
